mapper.sql: adjustment_id, plan_id, detail_id, adjustment_no, adjustment_type, adjustment_reason, original_amount, adjusted_amount, adjustment_amount, original_date, adjusted_date, approval_status, approve_user, approve_time, approve_comment, impact_assessment, risk_evaluation, org_id, create_user, create_time, update_user, update_time, is_deleted
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE adjustment_no = #{adjustmentNo} AND is_deleted = 0
SELECT FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE plan_id = #{planId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE detail_id = #{detailId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE approval_status = 'PENDING' AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE approval_status = 'REJECTED' AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY approve_time DESC
SELECT FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE ABS(adjustment_amount) >= #{impactThreshold} AND org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ABS(adjustment_amount) DESC
SELECT adjustment_type, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY adjustment_type
SELECT approval_status, COUNT(*) as count FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY approval_status

SELECT adjustment_type, COUNT(*) as adjustmentCount, COALESCE(SUM(adjustment_amount), 0) as totalAdjustmentAmount, COALESCE(AVG(adjustment_amount), 0) as avgAdjustmentAmount, COALESCE(MIN(adjustment_amount), 0) as minAdjustmentAmount, COALESCE(MAX(adjustment_amount), 0) as maxAdjustmentAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as approvalRate FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY adjustment_type ORDER BY totalAdjustmentAmount DESC

SELECT adjustment_type, COUNT(*) as totalCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 END) as rejectedCount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'PENDING' THEN 1 END) as pendingCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as approvalRate, COALESCE(AVG(CASE WHEN approve_time IS NOT NULL AND create_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, create_time, approve_time) END), 0) as avgApprovalHours FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY adjustment_type ORDER BY approvalRate DESC

SELECT CASE WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 500000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 100000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END as riskLevel, COUNT(*) as count, COALESCE(SUM(ABS(adjustment_amount)), 0) as totalAmount, COALESCE(AVG(ABS(adjustment_amount)), 0) as avgAmount, COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) as approvedCount, ROUND(COUNT(CASE WHEN approval_status = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) as approvalRate FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY CASE WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 500000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 100000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END ORDER BY CASE WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 500000 THEN 1 WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 100000 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END
mapper.update: UPDATE fund_plan_adjustment SET approval_status = #{approvalStatus}, approve_user = #{approveUser}, approve_time = #{approveTime}, approve_comment = #{approveComment}, update_user = #{approveUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_adjustment SET impact_assessment = #{impactAssessment}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_adjustment SET risk_evaluation = #{riskEvaluation}, update_user = #{updateUser}, update_time = NOW() WHERE adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_adjustment SET adjustment_amount = adjusted_amount - original_amount, update_time = NOW() WHERE adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} AND is_deleted = 0
UPDATE fund_plan_adjustment SET adjustment_amount = adjusted_amount - original_amount, update_time = NOW() WHERE org_id = #{orgId} AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_adjustment SET impact_assessment = CASE WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 1000000 THEN '重大影响：调整金额超过100万，需要高级管理层审批' WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 500000 THEN '较大影响：调整金额超过50万，需要部门负责人审批' WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 100000 THEN '中等影响：调整金额超过10万，需要财务经理审批' ELSE '轻微影响：调整金额较小，按正常流程审批' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} AND impact_assessment IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0

UPDATE fund_plan_adjustment SET risk_evaluation = CASE WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 1000000 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 500000 THEN 'MEDIUM' WHEN ABS(adjustment_amount) >= 100000 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END, update_time = NOW() WHERE adjustment_id = #{adjustmentId} AND risk_evaluation IS NULL AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE approval_status = 'PENDING' AND org_id = #{orgId} AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutHours} HOUR) AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC

SELECT FROM fund_plan_adjustment WHERE approval_status = 'PENDING' AND org_id = #{orgId} AND ABS(adjustment_amount) >= #{escalationThreshold} AND create_time < DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{timeoutHours} HOUR) AND is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ABS(adjustment_amount) DESC
